# Patterns in nature — Aizenberg and Mazzoleni corpora

**Card 11b · source workbook `ontology/xlsx/Patterns_in_Nature_Ontology_v3.xlsx` · generated by `scripts/build-knowledge.js` — do not edit by hand.**

## Scope boundary

Two research corpora feeding the pattern ontology. Aizenberg: laboratory work on structural colour, self-assembly, adaptive surfaces and bio-inspired materials, at the nanoscale to component scale. Mazzoleni: architectural and product case studies organised by function. Use these for worked precedents — what has actually been built from a pattern, by whom, and at what scale. The base ontology is card 11a.
